content:
### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows chrome).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 40):** App icon + title (left), Utility icons (center-right), Window controls (right).
*   **Sidebar (0, 40 - 280, 928):** Vertical navigation list. Contains section headers and selectable items.
    *   *Data Recovery Section:* Top group.
    *   *Advanced Features Section:* Middle group.
    *   *File Backup Section:* Bottom group.
*   **Main Content Area (280, 40 - 1024, 928):** Light gray background.
    *   *Header:* "Select a location..." (Top left of content area).
    *   *Internal Drives Section:* Label + Horizontal scroll/list of drive tiles.
    *   *Specify Location Section:* Label + Grid of location cards (Recycle Bin, Desktop, Select Folder).
    *   *Footer Bar (280, 840 - 1024, 928):* Sticky bottom bar containing help text (left) and primary CTA (right).
*   **Overlay / AI Assistant Panel (645, 180 - 965, 420):** Floating modal/card positioned over the main content (right side). Contains solution text and navigation controls.
*   **Taskbar (0, 928 - 1024, 768):** OS Taskbar at bottom.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar:**
    *   Header: `Data Recovery`
    *   Item 1: `Hardware Disk`
    *   Item 2: `SD Card`
    *   Item 3: `More Recovery Tools`
    *   Header: `Advanced Features`
    *   Item 4: `File Repair`
    *   Item 5: `Lost Partition Rescue`
    *   Header: `File Backup`
    *   Item 6: `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Area:**
    *   Heading: `Select a location to search for lost data`
    *   Subheading: `Internal drives (2)`
    *   Drive Tile Text: `Windows(C:)`, `28.28 GB/149.45 GB`
    *   Subheading: `Specify a location`
    *   Location Card 1: `Recycle Bin`
    *   Location Card 2: `Desktop`
    *   Location Card 3: `Select Folder`
    *   Footer Help: `Unable to find your hard drive?` (with info icon)
    *   Footer Button: `Search for Lost Data`
*   **AI Assistant Overlay:**
    *   Title: `Solution 1:`
    *   Body: `Refresh drives.`
    *   Pagination: `1/3`
    *   Button: `Next`
    *   Close Icon: `X` (visual)

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window Background (Sidebar): `#F5F6FA` (ESTIMATED Light Gray/Blueish White)
    *   Main Content Background: `#EAECEF` (ESTIMATED Light Gray)
    *   Sidebar Selected Item: `#DCE4F5` (ESTIMATED Light Blue)
    *   Overlay/AI Panel Background: `#2075FF` (ESTIMATED Bright Blue) -> Gradient likely to slightly lighter/darker blue.
    *   Footer Bar Background: `#FFFFFF` (White) or very light gray matching sidebar.
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings): `#1F1F1F` (ESTIMATED Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Subheadings): `#666666` (ESTIMATED Dark Gray)
    *   Sidebar Text (Selected): `#1F3864` (ESTIMATED Dark Blue)
    *   Sidebar Text (Normal): `#333333` (ESTIMATED Dark Gray)
    *   Overlay Text: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Button Text (Primary): `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Primary Action Blue: `#2660C4` (ESTIMATED Standard WinUI Blue) or `#0078D4`.
    *   Selection Checkmark/Ring: `#0078D4` (ESTIMATED System Accent Blue).
    *   Progress Bar Fill: `#0078D4` (Blue).
    *   Progress Bar Track: `#E0E0E0` (Light Gray).
    *   Tile Border (Selected): `#0078D4` (Blue, ~2px).
    *   Tile Border (Normal): `#CCCCCC` or transparent with shadow.

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular.
*   **Sidebar Headers:** Segoe UI, ~11-12px, Bold/DemiBold, Uppercase (or small caps styling), Dark Gray.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~13-14px, Regular.
*   **Main Heading:** Segoe UI/Semibold, ~20-24px.
*   **Subheadings ("Internal drives..."):** Segoe UI, ~13-14px, Regular, Gray.
*   **Tile Titles ("Windows(C:)"):** Segoe UI, ~14px, Medium/Bold.
*   **Tile Stats ("28.28 GB..."):** Segoe UI, ~11-12px, Regular, Gray.
*   **Overlay Title ("Solution 1:"):** Segoe UI, ~16-18px, Bold, White.
*   **Overlay Body:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Regular, White.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~44-48px.
*   **Sidebar Padding Left:** ~20px.
*   **Section Spacing (Sidebar):** ~20-30px vertical gap between groups.
*   **Main Content Padding:** ~30-40px from edges.
*   **Drive Tile Size:** ~320px width x ~110px height.
*   **Tile Internal Padding:** ~15px.
*   **Icon Size (Sidebar):** 24x24px or 32x32px.
*   **Icon Size (Tiles):** 48x64px (approx).
*   **Button Height (Footer):** ~44px.
*   **Button Height (Overlay "Next"):** ~32px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Tiles: ~4px - 6px.
    *   Buttons: ~4px.
    *   Overlay Panel: ~8px.
*   **Gutter (Tile Grid):** ~20px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List:**
    *   `Hardware Disk`: **State: Selected** (Blue background, blue text, green checkmark badge on right).
    *   `SD Card`: **State: Normal**.
    *   `More Recovery Tools`: **State: Normal**.
    *   `File Repair`, etc.: **State: Normal**.
*   **Drive Tiles:**
    *   `Windows(C:)`: **State: Selected** (Blue border, blue checkmark circle icon in top-right).
    *   (Other drive obscured/partially visible): **State: Normal**.
*   **Location Cards:**
    *   `Recycle Bin`, `Desktop`, `Select Folder`: **State: Normal** (Hoverable cards, flat design).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Search for Lost Data`: **State: Normal/Enabled** (Solid blue background, white text, rounded corners).
    *   `Next` (in overlay): **State: Normal/Enabled** (White button, blue text).
*   **Overlay:**
    *   Close 'X' button: Top right.
    *   Pagination indicator `1/3`: Pill shape, blue bg, white text.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline & Filled mix (Fluent Design / Modern Windows style).
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Grid of 4 squares (blue, filled).
    *   SD Card: SD card shape (gray outline/filled).
    *   Tools: Wrench/Screwdriver (gray).
    *   File Repair: Folder with tool (gray).
    *   Partition: Globe/Network node style (gray).
    *   Backup: Circular arrow (gray).
*   **Tile Icons:**
    *   Windows(C:): Hard drive icon (Windows logo on disk platter graphic).
    *   Recycle Bin: Bin icon (gray).
    *   Desktop: Monitor icon (gray).
    *   Select Folder: Folder icon (gray).
*   **Overlay Icon:** Robot/Mascot character head (White/Blue).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Ready**. The user is at the selection step. Data is loaded (drives are detected).
*   **Contextual State:** An **AI Assistant / Tip** is actively displayed ("Solution 1: Refresh drives"), suggesting an interactive tutorial or proactive help mode is active. The main window is dimmed (overlay modal state), though the dimming is subtle/light, implying the overlay might be non-blocking or the screenshot captures a specific "tip" popover state rather than a hard modal block.
*   **Motion Cues:** None static in image, but the "1/3" implies a carousel/slider capability.
